name: How long does it take to repair a gas line for a pool heater?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to repair a gas line for a pool heater?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a gas line repair for a pool heater depends on the specific issue. Minor leaks or simple repairs to accessible above-ground lines might be completed within a few hours. More complex situations, such as leaks in underground lines requiring excavation or extensive pipe replacement, could take a full day or even longer. Your technician can provide a more precise timeline after assessing the problem. Access to the gas line and the availability of parts can also affect the repair duration.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies from a few hours for minor leaks to a full day or more for complex issues like underground line repairs.
